svg.title: Binary Heap O(n) buildHeap, Two-Heaps Streaming Median, and Indexed Priority Queue
svg.desc: Animated diagram showing bottom-up O(n) buildHeap sifting down from floor(n/2)-1 across synchronized tree and 0-based flat array, Two-Heaps streaming median balancing maxHeap and minHeap in O(log n), and Indexed Priority Queue decreaseKey using inv[] lookup.
svg.text: Binary Heap O(n) buildHeap, Two-Heaps Median & Indexed Priority Queue
Bottom-Up siftDown from floor(n/2)-1, Dual-Heap Streaming Median O(1) Read, and O(1) Inverse Slot Mapping inv[]
n/2 leaves sift 0 levels; total work = n * sum(h / 2^h) = O(2n) = O(n).
Contrast: n repeated push() calls sift up from leaves -> O(n log n).
2. Two-Heaps Streaming Median (O(1) Read, O(log n) Push)

g.text: Push 10 -> Max-Heap! Order & size violated (10 > 8, diff=2)

svg.text: 3. Indexed Priority Queue: O(1) Key Lookup via inv[] for O(log n) decreaseKey(id, newPriority)

g.text: 1. Standard heap needs O(n) linear scan to find id=3.
2. Indexed PQ reads inv[3] = slot 3 in O(1) time!
3. Update keys[3] = 1, then siftUp(slot 3) swapping heap[] & inv[].
After siftUp: id=3 promoted to heap[0] (key = 1)!
Bijection Invariant: heap[inv[id]] === id and inv[heap[slot]] === slot
Swap(a, b) updates both heap[] and inv[] in O(1) per heap level.
Total decreaseKey cost: strictly O(log n) without duplicate heap entries.
